results.title: Anthropic in talks to buy Decart AI, source says
results.description: Aug 12 (Reuters) - ⁠Anthropic is in talks to buy Nvidia-backed startup Decart AI, ⁠according to a source familiar with the matter, as ‌the Claude maker explores acquisitions that could help it handle growing demand ahead of its public listing.

results.title: Pause All Laravel Queues During a Deploy
results.description: Laravel 13.25 adds queue:pause --all and Queue::pauseAll() to stop job processing on every connection without putting the app in maintenance mode. The post Pause All Laravel Queues During a Deploy appeared first on Laravel News . Join the Laravel Newsletter to get Laravel articles like this directly in your inbox.

results.title: German watchdog takes Meta to court over alleged privacy breaches linked to AI glasses
results.description: A German advocacy group has filed a criminal complaint against Meta and other companies selling the technology group’s AI glasses in Germany, arguing the devices violate privacy laws. Digital rights group HateAid said in a statement on Wednesday that the launch of the devices, the Ray-Ban Meta Wayfarer in particular, broke German digital privacy laws, in the latest sign of legal scrutiny in a nation where the right to privacy is highly valued. “There’s no place to escape from smart glasses.
